name: Jolla Phone 2 (JP2601)
_comment: Shipped device profile: measured corrections for this camera module (docs/DEVICE-PROFILES.md). A key in your own override-hal.json replaces the same key here.

cameras._focus_calibration_note: Measured on one JP2 (scripts/focus-calib.sh, October 2026): the HAL's lens value for each real distance, interpolated in diopters. A user's own table (override-hal.json or the calibration assistant) replaces these distances and adds others. Camera 2 (the 18 mm) focuses too and has no table yet.

overrides._note: Tested on a JP2 (November 2026): a manual exposure is taken up to ISO 16000 and 0.5 s, beyond the declared range; the camera's own automatic exposure goes to ISO 15537.
The 18 mm. Tested on a JP2 (November 2026): a manual exposure is taken up to ISO 16000 and 0.5 s, beyond the declared 2400 and 0.1 s; the camera's own automatic exposure goes to ISO 15537.
overrides._touch_note: The 18 mm's AUTO focus search scans only from where the lens is towards infinity (trace of 14 Nov 2026): from a manual distance near infinity it missed closer subjects. Its continuous search finds them: a focus touch searches with it, then locks (rawfish-ir.conf focusTouchContinuous=1 while this is tested).
